name: Page Title Check
details: Document title accurately matches the target page.

name: Skip Link Presence
details: Exactly one a.skip-link element exists in the document.

name: Skip Link Href Target
details: Skip link anchor references the main content container (#main).

name: Main Target Presence and Semantics
details: Main content region is wrapped in <main id="main" tabindex="-1">.

name: Retained Teaching Purpose
details: Demonstration bad-semantics tags (<font size="7">, <font size="5">) are preserved.

name: Demonstrated CSS Layout Preserved (Unfocused)
details: Skip link is visually clipped/off-screen; heading layout is unchanged from baseline.

name: Tab Traversal to Interactive Control
details: Pressing Tab immediately focuses the skip link.

name: Visible Focus Indication
details: Skip link displays with high contrast, 2px white border, and 3px blue outline on focus.

name: Keyboard Activation URL Hash
details: Pressing Enter updates the browser URL hash to #main.

name: Keyboard Activation Focus Transfer
details: Focus is transferred to the main content container (#main) upon activation.
